description.en: Retro 8-bit pixel art style UI components built on top of shadcn/ui.
description.zh: 复古 8 位像素艺术风格的 shadcn/ui 组件库，还原街机与怀旧游戏机界面质感。

content.en: 8bitcn brings retro gaming nostalgia to modern web interfaces by reimagining shadcn/ui with an 8-bit pixel aesthetic. It features pixelated borders, retro typography, gaming HUD dialogs, and vintage buttons compatible with the standard shadcn CLI workflow.
content.zh: 8bitcn 将经典街机与复古像素游戏机的视觉风貌带入现代前端世界。它将 shadcn/ui 的核心组件库全部以 8-bit 像素艺术重新绘制，具有硬朗的阶梯像素边框、经典复古字体与生命值/技能槽式控件，兼容 shadcn CLI 工作流，极客与怀旧风味浓郁。
